subject.title: [Bug]: agent --json returns pre-hook assistant text instead of finalized before_message_write output

question: When `before_message_write` blocks the CLI assistant message, what should `agent --json` return instead of the raw pre-hook assistant text?
rationale: The current behavior can expose assistant text that a plugin blocked or rewrote before transcript persistence, and the replacement JSON shape is a security/product contract for downstream automation.

options.title: Suppress blocked assistant payload
options.body: Treat a blocked `before_message_write` result as suppressing the JSON assistant payload too, with optional non-sensitive metadata explaining the hook block.

options.title: Return a safe placeholder
options.body: Return a fixed non-sensitive placeholder payload so callers receive a terminal result without seeing blocked content.

options.title: Keep raw JSON output
options.body: Preserve the current raw-payload behavior and accept that `before_message_write` does not protect the CLI JSON surface.

recommendation.title: Suppress blocked assistant payload
recommendation.body: Treat a blocked `before_message_write` result as suppressing the JSON assistant payload too, with optional non-sensitive metadata explaining the hook block.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent CLI, transcript, and plugin hook history makes `vincentkoc` the best available routing owner for the hook-boundary decision.
